name: Anouk Van Brug-Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on European Central Bank – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how the European Central Bank has handled money and prices over the past year. It welcomes the fall in inflation from its 2022 peak but says the Bank was slow to react and must improve its forecasting models. It asks the Bank to keep interest rates from falling too fast, to explain better how it meets its wider goals, to make the digital euro useful and private, and to keep cash available.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament gives its view and asks the Bank to act on several points.
- **Who it affects:** The European Central Bank, banks, and people using the euro.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to the Council, the Commission and the Bank.
